notes.title: Official Release of Nyxerion Version 1.0 the 20/06/2025 !
notes.notes:
Nyxerion comes out this Friday ! The game will be released on June 20, 2025



Version 1.0 includes:

5 playable characters, each with unique abilities and playstyles

2 maps, designed for fast-paced and strategic combat

General optimizations and gameplay adjustments

This launch is just the beginning.

Nyxerion is ready.
